title: Finite-free signed coordinate map exists
statement: Under the two-term support and unit identifications, the finite-free coordinate construction produces an isomorphism in each degree satisfying the signed evaluation formula.

proof.text: Decompose the total tensor degree into the two surviving coefficient summands, transport each unit summand through the tensor-Hom adjunction, and use the product universal property to assemble the signed coordinate map. The coordinate signs square to one.
